description: This file contains unit tests for the TailscaleServeGatewayDiscovery module, specifically testing gateway discovery mechanisms, executable path resolution, and environment setup for subprocesses related to Tailscale on macOS.

methods.name: `discovers serve gateway from tailnet peers`
methods.description: Asynchronously tests the discovery of a serve gateway from tailnet peers based on mock status JSON.

methods.name: `returns empty when status unavailable`
methods.description: Tests that discovery returns an empty result when the Tailscale status is unavailable.

methods.name: `resolves bare executable from PATH`
methods.description: Tests the ability to resolve the 'tailscale' executable in a temporary directory added to PATH.

methods.name: `rejects missing executable candidate`
methods.description: Checks that resolving an executable that does not exist returns nil.

methods.name: `adds TERM for GUI-launched tailscale subprocesses`
methods.description: Verifies that the environment setup adds the TERM variable when launching tailscale subprocesses.

methods.name: `preserves existing TERM when building tailscale subprocess environment`
methods.description: Ensures existing TERM environment variable is maintained when setting up subprocess environment.
